NAV S$10,366,533 · watcher −0.10% (indicative; navHistory +0.03%) · listed flag −0.54%

  • The one thing: the first-hike playbook is running (sell-off on the hike, relief bounce day 1), but the week is not over: BOJ decision ~11:00am SGT today (fully-priced +25bp to 1.25%, highest since 1995) and US quad witching. China tail-risk cut: US delays excess-capacity tariffs until after the Xi summit; Wang Yi-Rubio call; Bessent AI talks this weekend.

Congress trades (Sep 14–18 window)

  • No new disclosures in the last 24h — feed top unchanged since Sep 16
  • Window: FL-19 Rep HWM/PH sells + NFLX buys (9/16); NJ-5 Dem two-sided MSFT options $250K-$1M + QSR/AMAT/RSG buys (9/15); WA-1 Dem NYC muni buy (9/15); TX-11 Rep CHTR/LBRDK exchange (9/15); Sen. King EA sell (9/14); Kean NJ-7 MSFT/GOOGL/AMCR/JNJ sells + LIN/MTZ buys (9/14). Unusual Whales

Trump / policy watch (24–48h)

  • Grid/AI tape: Generac-Amazon generator deal; Nexperia-Tata wafer partnership; StanChart now expects another Fed hike Dec 2026; Dimon: "not clear we've slayed inflation"

Alpha — signals, not advice (~62% cash undeployed)

  • Defense 15% vs ~0%: catalysts stacked (F-35/Saudi $24.3bn, UBS LMT Buy, Russia-Iran bill) and 10y eased to ~4.94% — better entry than 5%+; tranche-build trigger stays live

trumpWatch.title: US delays excess-capacity tariffs until after the Xi summit
trumpWatch.detail: Bloomberg via Newsquawk Sep 18. Direct de-escalation for the HK AI barbell; pairs with Wang Yi-Rubio phone call and Bessent's US-China AI talks running this weekend.

trumpWatch.title: State Dept approved potential F-35 sale to Saudi Arabia (~$24.3bn, Lockheed)
trumpWatch.detail: Approved despite this week's NYT intel warning on China tech-leakage risk. Separately (Sep 10): UBS upgraded LMT to Buy, $674 target, seeing missiles revenue +150% through 2030. Defense budget-cycle bid intact.

trumpWatch.title: Trump to sign Russia-Iran sanctions bill; 'critical juncture' on the Iran war
trumpWatch.detail: AP/White House official: signing planned, RFERL says as early as today Sep 18. Trump told Axios he is weighing 'massive new attacks' vs a different path; an adviser to Iran's Supreme Leader (Tasnim) said Hormuz will not reopen until Trump/Netanyahu are removed. Weekend Hormuz headline risk is live.

trumpWatch.title: Trump to Warsh: 'You might as well vote with the board because it's not going to matter'
trumpWatch.detail: Trump said he spoke with Warsh before the FOMC (Yahoo Sep 17). The open White House-Fed conflict now runs alongside an active hiking cycle. Same session: Trump banned Canadian goods from US government purchases (~$280bn procurement per Toronto Star; Section 338 import bans effective Sep 29) while Politico reports the US and Mexico are close to a trade deal after the Trump-Sheinbaum call.

trumpWatch.title: BoE hawkish hold at 3.75% (3 dissenters wanted +25bp); BOJ decides today ~11:00am SGT
trumpWatch.detail: Bailey: 'the longer this volatility persists... the more likely we will need to raise Bank Rate.' Barclays now pencils +25bp Nov + Feb 2027; Standard Chartered now expects another Fed hike Dec 2026. BOJ expected +25bp to 1.25% (highest since 1995), fully priced; Japan Aug CPI due 07:30 SGT (print not captured at brief time); Ueda presser 14:30 SGT.

trumpWatch.title: Grid/AI tape: Generac-Amazon generator deal; Nexperia-Tata wafer pact; Dimon on inflation
trumpWatch.detail: GNRC signed a generator supply deal with AMZN for data-center power; Nexperia + Tata Electronics semiconductor wafer-manufacturing partnership; US spectrum auctions could raise $100B+; US sold $19bn 10y TIPS at a soft 1.9bp tail; Dimon: 'not clear we've slayed inflation,' wants light-touch federal AI oversight; polling: 70% of Americans say AI is moving too fast.
